jobs.title: Manager, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
The Role: 
Minted is looking for an operational lead to manage and scale the supply chain network for our core stationery business. In this role, you will oversee supplier relationships, optimize peak-season capacity, and ensure our print and fulfillment partners deliver exceptional quality on tight timelines.
You will sit at the intersection of supply chain strategy, vendor operations, and cross-functional execution—working directly with external manufacturing partners and internal product, engineering, and customer ops teams to drive down costs while keeping customer satisfaction high.


You will: 
- Vendor & Network Management: Directly manage our network of manufacturers. Monitor day-to-day vendor performance across key metrics like on-time delivery, defect rates, and unit costs.

- Capacity Planning & Scaling: Build capacity models and route orders dynamically to support aggressive sales growth and seasonal spikes. Onboard new manufacturing partners & vendors as needed.

- Fulfillment Strategy: Own execution strategies for specialty products like foil-pressed cards, maximizing throughput and operational efficiency while keeping capital expenditures low.

- Quality Control & Customer Advocacy: Partner with Customer Operations to analyze feedback, identify root causes for late or damaged orders, and execute corrective action plans directly with vendors.

- Cross-Functional & Systems Improvements: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to translate operational needs into technical specifications for our routing, inventory, and order-management systems.
You have: 
- 5+ years of experience in on-demand supply chain, manufacturing, vendor operations, or e-commerce fulfillment.

- Data & Modeling Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and BI tools (e.g., Looker) to build cost, forecasting, and capacity models. Experience in utilizing AI to automate manual processes & build efficiencies.

- Vendor Management: Proven track record of managing third-party manufacturers/3PLs, enforcing SLAs, and running quarterly business reviews.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Ability to translate complex supply chain trade-offs to product managers, engineers, and executive stakeholders.

- Peak Season Experience: Experience navigating high-volume e-commerce seasonality, especially with on-demand D2C fulfillment.
Bonus Points: 
- Background in print, paper, custom manufacturing, or high-SKU/personalized e-commerce.

- Degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field.
Compensation: 
 
The compensation range for the role applies to employment offers from Minted. Our employment offers fall between the minimum and midpoint of the range to allow for continued salary growth during your employment at Minted. The upper half of the range accommodates this growth and supports our intention to create an environment that encourages lasting relationships between Minted and our employees.
Minted utilizes a market-based compensation model with four geographic tiers. Final compensation is determined based on the candidate’s primary work location, defined as their residence within 60 miles of a metropolitan area:
 
Geo 2: Boston, MA; Washington, DC; Chicago, IL; Seattle, WA; Austin, TX; Atlanta, GA; Portland, OR - $89,080 - $116,918
Geo 3: All other U.S. metro locations - $81,744 - $107,289
 
Salaries will vary based on various factors, including but not limited to professional and academic experience, associated job responsibilities, and/or other business or organizational needs.
 
This role is eligible for bonus and stock options.
 
Benefits: 
Benefits will be effective on the first of each month following your initial hire date. 
 
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
- Employer-Funded Health Savings Account

About Minted:

Artists shape culture. They spark conversation, create connection, and bring beauty into the world. Minted is where they come together to reach further. Our marketplace empowers a thriving community of independent artists to sell and scale their work. We nurture self-expression, cultivate community, and bring the best in visual art to a global audience.

We’re building a new way to discover the world’s best creative talent. We’re here for the emerging talent ready to take off, the local favorites ready to grow, and the established artists ready to dream bigger.

At Minted, our people don’t just believe in the power of art–we live it. We have our finger on the pulse of what’s new and now. We’re obsessed with great design, art, and interiors. We’re in galleries, at fairs, and constantly finding inspiration online. We seek undiscovered talent that deserves to stand up and stand out. We connect with artists that have something to say, and we collaborate to amplify their work.  The Minted community’s art, stationery, and textiles products have reached over 75 million homes worldwide.

Our marketplace brings the best in independent design to consumers everywhere. We recognize the challenges independent artists face, and we leverage our resources to level the playing field and create a platform that gives artists the freedom to develop their craft and grow their business.

We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA and currently employ 350+ full-time employees, plus additional temporary workers during the holiday season. We have raised over $300M from top-tier investors including Benchmark Capital, T. Rowe Price, Permira, Ridge Ventures, Technology Crossover Ventures, and Norwest Venture Partners.  Angel investors include Marissa Mayer, Jeremy Stoppelman, Julia & Kevin Hartz, Yishan Wong, and more.

Minted is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion and diversity. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and will consider all qualified applicants for employment in accordance with all state, local, and federal laws. Minted participates in the E-verify program.

How Our Process Works:

Minted uses technology and innovative practices to bring unique, best-selling design to market at scale. Using its crowdsourcing technology, consumers are empowered to vote for the designs they love and want to see sold, ensuring that Minted always sells continuously fresh and trend-forward product. The winning designs are manufactured by Minted, enabling artists from around the world to share and sell their work while letting Minted do the rest. Since launch in 2007, the company has expanded to serve consumers in new categories including wall art, textiles, digital content and home decor, as well as serve major retailers and consumer products brands with data-backed design through licensing and wholesale partnerships.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Sourcing & Supply
jobs.description:
The Role: 
 
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Global Sourcing & Supply to lead the strategy, development, and performance of Minted’s global supplier network, ensuring we have the right partners, capabilities, economics, capacity, compliance, and supply plans to support our current business and future product growth.
This role will partner closely with Product Development, Business Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Logistics, Planning, Finance, and Legal to shape sourcing and supply strategies from early product development through commercialization, production, and ongoing supply. You will lead key supplier relationships and commercial negotiations, oversee sourcing and supply planning across the portfolio, and proactively manage cost, capacity, quality, inventory, compliance, and supply risk.
This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who combines strong commercial and strategic judgment with deep sourcing and supply expertise and is comfortable moving between long-term strategy and hands-on problem-solving.

You will:
- Lead global sourcing and supply strategies across assigned product categories, ensuring the supplier network has the capabilities, capacity, cost structure, quality, compliance, and resilience needed to support business objectives.

- Develop and evolve the global supplier portfolio, including identifying capability gaps, evaluating new sourcing markets and manufacturing partners, and leading the qualification and onboarding of strategic suppliers.

- Partner with Product Development and Business Operations early in the product development process to inform supplier selection, manufacturability, target costs, materials, lead times, and commercialization strategies.

- Provide oversight of new product development and commercialization, ensuring complex or strategically important programs are effectively transitioned from concept through scaled production.

- Own strategic supplier relationships and lead major commercial negotiations, including pricing frameworks, MOQs, lead times, payment terms, capacity commitments, and other key commercial terms.

- Develop and lead cost-management and value-engineering strategies across the portfolio, identifying opportunities to improve product economics through supplier negotiations, materials, manufacturing methods, product specifications, sourcing decisions, and landed-cost optimization.

- Provide oversight of supply and inventory planning across the portfolio, ensuring demand forecasts are translated into appropriate purchasing, production, and inventory strategies that balance availability, lead times, capacity, MOQs, and supply risk.

- Partner with Planning and Supply Chain teams to identify longer-term demand, capacity, and inventory risks and ensure appropriate mitigation plans are in place.

- Lead supplier capacity and production-readiness planning, particularly for major product launches, seasonal demand, and Peak, ensuring sufficient materials, tooling, labor, equipment, and contingency plans are in place.

- Own the compliance framework for the global supplier network, ensuring suppliers meet Minted’s requirements related to responsible sourcing, product and regulatory compliance, documentation, testing, and other applicable standards.

- Partner with Logistics, Finance, Legal, and external customs and trade partners to ensure compliance with import/export requirements, customs regulations, product classification, country-of-origin requirements, duties, tariffs, and required shipping documentation.

- Monitor changes in tariffs, duties, trade regulations, and sourcing-country requirements; assess potential cost and supply implications and develop mitigation strategies as appropriate.

- Proactively identify and mitigate global sourcing and supply risks, including supplier concentration, capacity constraints, material availability, long lead times, geopolitical exposure, trade and compliance risk, tariffs, quality issues, and other potential disruptions.

- Establish and manage supplier performance expectations across cost, quality, delivery, responsiveness, capacity, compliance, and continuous improvement, using scorecards, business reviews, corrective-action plans, and executive escalation as appropriate.

- Partner with Quality to ensure appropriate supplier quality systems, product specifications, testing, inspection standards, and corrective-action processes are established and maintained.

- Partner with Logistics and Supply Chain to ensure sourcing and production strategies appropriately account for freight, lead times, shipment timing, inventory requirements, customs and import requirements, duties and tariffs, and overall landed-cost considerations.

- Build strong relationships with supplier ownership and senior leadership, creating productive long-term partnerships while maintaining clear accountability for performance.

- Identify emerging manufacturing technologies, materials, supplier capabilities, and sourcing opportunities that can enable product innovation, improve economics, or strengthen Minted’s supply network.

- Establish clear operating rhythms, processes, and visibility across sourcing, development, production, inventory, compliance, and supplier performance to enable proactive decision-making and escalation.

- Provide leadership, coaching, prioritization, and development for members of the Global Sourcing & Supply team.

- Travel internationally as required for supplier visits, strategic business reviews, product development, production reviews, and sourcing activities.
You have: 
- 8+ years of progressive experience in global sourcing, supply management, product development, manufacturing, or related supply chain roles.

- Significant experience working directly with global manufacturers and managing complex supplier relationships, ideally in consumer products, home, stationery, gifting, retail, or other design-led categories.

- Demonstrated experience developing and executing sourcing strategies across multiple products, categories, or suppliers.

- Strong commercial experience, including strategic supplier negotiations, cost management, pricing, MOQs, payment terms, and value engineering.

- Strong understanding of supply and inventory planning, demand forecasting, production planning, capacity management, and purchase-order processes.

- Deep understanding of product development and manufacturing processes from concept through commercialization and scaled production.

- Experience managing supplier compliance and working knowledge of international trade requirements, including customs, duties, tariffs, country of origin, product classification, and import documentation.

- Demonstrated ability to assess and manage supplier performance, capacity, quality, compliance, and supply risk.

- Strong analytical and financial acumen with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs across cost, landed cost, quality, inventory, speed, innovation, compliance, and risk.

- Excellent relationship-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior internal stakeholders and supplier leadership.

- Experience leading, coaching, or developing team members.

- Comfortable operating both strategically and hands-on in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.

- Willingness to travel internationally.

Our employment offers fall between the minimum and midpoint of the range to allow for continued salary growth during your employment at Minted. The upper half of the range accommodates this growth and supports our intention to create an environment that encourages lasting relationships between Minted and our employees.
Minted utilizes a market-based compensation model with four geographic tiers. Final compensation is determined based on the candidate’s primary work location, defined as their residence within 60 miles of a metropolitan area:
 
Geo 2: Boston, MA; Washington, DC; Chicago, IL; Seattle, WA; Austin, TX; Atlanta, GA; Portland, OR - $114,429 - $150,188
Geo 3: All other U.S. metro locations - $105,005 - $137,820
 
Salaries will vary based on various factors, including but not limited to professional and academic experience, associated job responsibilities, and/or other business or organizational needs.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Logistics Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Supply Chain Logistics Manager to lead Minted’s end-to-end transportation network—from inbound freight originating with overseas suppliers through final-mile delivery to our DTC customers and wholesale partners.
This role will own logistics performance, cost, carrier strategy and relationships, and continuous improvement, ensuring our network delivers the right balance of speed, reliability, cost, and scalability. You will partner closely with our fulfillment network, overseas vendors, 3PLs, Customer Service, technology teams, and internal business partners.
This could be a hybrid role based in San Francisco, with an expectation of working onsite 3 days per week or remote if based outside of the Bay Area.

You will: 
DTC & Last-Mile Logistics

- Own and optimize Minted’s DTC parcel network across carriers, service levels, fulfillment locations, and product categories.

- Manage carrier performance, relationships, and contracts, including rate and contract negotiations, SLA management, and evaluation of new carriers and services.

- Analyze shipping costs, service levels, surcharges, routing, and package characteristics to improve delivery performance and reduce cost per package.

- Partner with fulfillment and technology teams to optimize carrier selection, shipping-service logic, and end-to-end shipment visibility.

- Serve as the primary logistics partner to Customer Service, ensuring time-sensitive and high-priority customer shipments receive appropriate escalation and resolution.

Peak Planning & Execution

- Lead transportation readiness for Peak, translating business forecasts into carrier- and service-level volume forecasts and capacity requirements.

- Coordinate with carriers and fulfillment partners to ensure appropriate pickup schedules, capacity, and contingency plans are in place at each location.

- Monitor Peak performance and proactively communicate shipping forecasts, service risks, capacity constraints, surcharge changes, and cost implications to the business.

International & Inbound Logistics

- Own inbound transportation from overseas suppliers through delivery to Minted fulfillment locations, distribution centers, and wholesale destinations.

- Manage freight forwarders, customs brokers, 3PLs, and overseas vendors to ensure shipments are planned, documented, tracked, and delivered on time.

- Optimize ocean, air, and domestic inbound freight based on cost, lead time, and inventory requirements, including consolidation, mode selection, and total landed cost.

- Maintain strong working knowledge of Incoterms, customs processes, duties, international shipping documentation, and trade-compliance requirements.

Wholesale & Distribution Logistics

- Manage logistics requirements for wholesale and retail programs, including routing guides, labeling, appointments, EDI, and delivery compliance.

- Monitor and resolve freight-related chargebacks and deductions, and ensure logistics readiness for new customers, programs, and product launches.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

- Own logistics KPIs, transportation forecasts, and cost-to-serve analysis, translating data into actionable operational and financial improvements.

- Identify and execute initiatives that reduce transportation cost, improve transit times and reliability, and strengthen network resilience.

- Partner with Engineering, Product, and IT to automate workflows, improve data accuracy, and enhance shipment visibility.

- Serve as the cross-functional  voice of logistics , ensuring transportation considerations, risks, and costs are incorporated into business decisions.
You have:
- 5+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, with meaningful experience in both DTC parcel / last-mile shipping and international inbound logistics .

- Deep knowledge of the U.S. parcel ecosystem, including national and regional carriers, service levels, pricing, surcharges, and carrier performance management.

- Experience managing carrier contracts, transportation pricing, and commercial negotiations.

- Hands-on experience with international freight, including ocean and air transportation, freight forwarders, customs brokers, Incoterms, and inbound coordination.

- Experience planning carrier capacity and transportation operations for high-volume seasonal or Peak periods.

- Experience with multi-node fulfillment, 3PL, and wholesale or retail distribution environments.

- Strong analytical and financial skills, with experience using data to evaluate transportation costs, forecast demand, and drive cost and service improvements.

- Strong operational judgment and cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to identify risks early and drive issues through resolution.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist, Wholesale (In-Store Operations)
jobs.description:
You will: 
- Merchandising Operations & Execution:

- Plan and execute in-store operations for Seasonal and Mainstay card programs to ensure quality and consistency.

-

-
Partner with 3rd party merchandisers for flawless execution of weekly store maintenance, including branded signage installation and replenishment triaging.

-
Coordinate with third-party partners to launch new stores, manage store remodels, and oversee store closures.

-
Support the launch and execution of new Wholesale programs by managing in-store execution and ensuring accountability.

-
Data, Reporting & Performance Visibility:

-
Summarize in-store operations weekly metrics and present them to key stakeholder teams in a digestible way to showcase the team’s efficiency and operational impact.

-
Develop and implement accurate, scalable, and refreshable reporting for performance metrics across the Wholesale Greeting Card supply chain.

-
Track data associated with 3rd party merchandisers to ensure completion compliance for everyday and seasonal programs.

-
Provide critical operations store-level updates for Seasonal card programs.

-
Inventory Oversight & Asset Management:

-
Collaborate with Inventory Specialists to address specific store-level inventory needs and allocations.

-
Oversee and maintain records for the store footprint and card fixtures.

-
Provide analytical support in cost negotiations with Wholesale partners.
You are: 
- Proactive and results-focused, with the ability to learn quickly and prioritize effectively.

- Experienced in demand planning and inventory management.

- Detail- and process-oriented with strong organizational skills.

- Analytically minded with the ability to leverage large sets of data to deliver actionable insights.

- A creative problem solver obsessed with product quality and operational excellence.
You have: 
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.

- 1-3 years of experience working in operations or supply chain (academic experience considered).

- Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners.
